Downloadit
https://www.downloadit.pro

A free public-media downloader for Instagram, Pinterest, and YouTube. Paste a public link, preview the available media, and save it without an account. No login required, nothing to install.

Instagram Downloader Features:
- Instagram Reels Downloader: Save public Reels as MP4 with original audio
- Instagram Video Downloader: Save public video posts as MP4
- Instagram Photo & Carousel Downloader: Save photos and carousels as JPG, PNG, or WebP
- Instagram Story Downloader: Save public Stories before they expire (24-hour window)
- Instagram Audio Downloader: Extract audio from public Reels and videos as MP3

Pinterest Downloader Features:
- Pinterest Video Downloader: Save public Pinterest video pins as MP4
- Pinterest Image & Carousel Downloader: Save Pinterest images and carousels in original quality

YouTube Downloader Features:
- YouTube Video Downloader: Download public YouTube videos as MP4 (up to 1080p) or extract audio as MP3/M4A

Supported Media Types:
- Video: MP4
- Images: JPG, PNG, WebP
- Audio: MP3, M4A

How Visitors Can Use the Website:
1. Copy a public link from Instagram, Pinterest, or YouTube
2. Paste the link into the downloader input box on the relevant page
3. Select Get Media to preview the available media
4. Select Download to save the file to your device

Privacy and No-Login:
Downloadit does not require an account, login, or password. It only accesses publicly available media that a logged-out visitor could already see. No user data is stored.
